visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair pulled back stands in a brightly lit hallway in front of a white paneled door. She wears a light pink button-up cardigan over a dark top and wide-leg dark grey cargo pants. Her expression is stern and impatient as she holds a grey shaker bottle in her hand. She begins walking briskly and forcefully towards the camera, mimicking a heavy 'stomping' motion. (2) The scene cuts to a kitchen where a man in a purple t-shirt and dark pants stands before an open side-by-side refrigerator. The kitchen features white cabinetry and light-colored walls. He appears frantic, looking around the shelves with wide eyes. He quickly reaches into the top freezer section, grabbing various frozen containers and bottles and tossing them downwards with exaggerated, panicked movements, creating a scene of desperate searching.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a sequence of heavy, percussive thuds representing rhythmic footsteps on a hard, resonant floor. Each thud has a sharp transient attack and a quick decay, conveying physical weight and an aggressive pace. No voices or background music are audible during this phase. (2) A sharp acoustic transition introduces a chaotic burst of sound as objects are tossed. Multiple high-frequency clatters and mid-range thuds from plastic and metal containers striking hard surfaces occur in rapid succession. This phase is characterized by a dense layer of rustling plastic bags and the sliding sounds of hard surfaces, creating a frantic auditory texture.
